## First Solar, Inc. to Announce Third Quarter 2026 Financial Results on October 29, 2026


October 15, 2026


PHOENIX--(BUSINESS WIRE)--


First Solar, Inc. (NASDAQ: FSLR) (the “Company”) will report financial results for the third quarter ended September 30, 2026, after the market closes on Thursday, October 29, 2026.


Conference Call Details are as follows:


**Date:** Thursday, October 29, 2026


**Time:** 4:30 PM ET


**Live Webcast:**[investor.firstsolar.com](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Finvestor.firstsolar.com%2Foverview%2Fdefault.aspx&esheet=54621524&newsitemid=20261015638937&lan=en-US&anchor=investor.firstsolar.com&index=1&md5=4ef8921e859e2f4aa146d44bc077ae17)


**Webcast Replay:** Available through Saturday, November 28, 2026


- Investors section of the Company's website approximately two hours after the call


**About First Solar, Inc.**


First Solar, Inc. is America's leading photovoltaic (“PV”) solar technology and manufacturing company. The only US-headquartered company among the world's largest solar manufacturers, First Solar is focused on competitively and reliably enabling power generation needs with its advanced, uniquely American thin film PV technology. Developed at R&D labs in California and Ohio, the Company's technology provides a competitive, high-performance, and responsibly produced alternative to conventional crystalline silicon PV modules. For more information, please visit[www.firstsolar.com](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=http%3A%2F%2Fwww.firstsolar.com&esheet=54621524&newsitemid=20261015638937&lan=en-US&anchor=www.firstsolar.com&index=2&md5=272da6f4b6abf097b430c176a6d41f03) .
